- 20% lift in search and LLM-recommendation visibility at Apsis Solutions Inc through GEO and LLM-indexing standards, validated against live analytics.

- 60–80% reduction in document retrieval time at USF Health Byrd Alzheimer's Institute via a Python OCR search system (pytesseract, pdfplumber).
- 30% Google Search optimization gain and 80% faster page loads at BHM Healthcare (Google PageSpeed Insights).
- 22% production throughput increase at Avizorca via a React vehicle-inspection intake form feeding Google Sheets.
